questions.stem_text:
The four big moons of Jupiter are Callisto Europa Ganymede and Io. Which one of them has
the smallest distance to Jupiter?

options.C: dark lavas filling older impact basins
options.D: the bright regions on the Moon

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - dark lavas filling older impact basins

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following was not cited as evidence for life in the martian meteorite
ALH84001?

options.B: Magnetite grains similar to those formed by bacteria on Earth
options.C: Carbonate minerals indicating a thicker warmer Martian atmosphere
options.D: Amino acids with a preferred orientation or "chirality"

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Amino acids with a preferred orientation or "chirality"

questions.stem_text: What about asteroids makes them stand out in sky surveys searching for them?

options.B: Asteroids emit a lot of their own radiation
options.C: They reflect enough of the sun's light to make them brighter than most background stars
options.D: Asteroids have substantial motion relative to the background stars

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Asteroids have substantial motion relative to the background stars

questions.stem_text:
What effect or effects would be most significant if the Moon's orbital plane were exactly
the same as the ecliptic plane?

options.A: Solar eclipses would be much rarer.
options.B: Solar eclipses would last much longer.
options.C: Solar eclipses would be much more frequent.
options.D: Solar eclipses would not last as long.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Solar eclipses would be much more frequent.
